items.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: Clark Terry you know had some terrible experiences.

ctx.x: And they don’t complain about it.

No that generation, no they’re very cool. I mean Buck — that’s another irony is that the guys who lived through that, I mean Clark Terry you know had some terrible experiences. Buck Clayton like told me himself about one time when I think he was down south and I can’t remember the exact story but like two carloads of these rednecks pulled up, and he thought that was it. He thought he was going to die. I mean he was in situations where his life was on the line just because of the color of his skin. And yet he bore…
I know what you’re saying though.
